sql: SELECT c."Character Name" FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID WHERE m.Title='Batman' ORDER BY c.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT m.Title FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE a.Name='Tom Cruise'
SELECT c."Character Name" FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE a.Name='Tom Cruise' AND m.Title='Born on the Fourth of July'
SELECT AVG(m.Rating) FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE a.Name='Tom Cruise'

SELECT CAST(MAX((CAST(substr(c.screentime,1,instr(c.screentime,':')-1) AS INTEGER)*3600 + CAST(substr(c.screentime,instr(c.screentime,':')+1,2) AS INTEGER)*60 + CAST(substr(c.screentime,-2) AS INTEGER))) - MIN((CAST(substr(c.screentime,1,instr(c.screentime,':')-1) AS INTEGER)*3600 + CAST(substr(c.screentime,instr(c.screentime,':')+1,2) AS INTEGER)*60 + CAST(substr(c.screentime,-2) AS INTEGER))) AS REAL) * 100 / MIN((CAST(substr(c.screentime,1,instr(c.screentime,':')-1) AS INTEGER)*3600 + CAST(substr(c.screentime,instr(c.screentime,':')+1,2) AS INTEGER)*60 + CAST(substr(c.screentime,-2) AS INTEGER))) FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID WHERE m.Title='Batman' AND c.screentime IS NOT NULL
SELECT c."Character Name" FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID WHERE m.Genre='Thriller' AND c.creditOrder=1 ORDER BY m.Rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT a.Name FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE m.Title='Batman' ORDER BY c.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT a."Birth City" FROM characters c JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE c."Character Name"='Gabriel Martin'
SELECT a.Name FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE m.Title='American Hustle' AND c.creditOrder=2
SELECT a.Name FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE m."Release Date"='2015-10-26' AND c.creditOrder=1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a."Birth Country"='USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(a.ActorID) FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE m.Title='Mrs. Doubtfire'
SELECT Name FROM actor WHERE ActorID=439 AND Gender='Male' AND Ethnicity='White'
SELECT a.NetWorth, a."Date of Birth" FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE m.Title='Die Hard 2' AND a."Height (Inches)" BETWEEN 60 AND 65

SELECT m.Gross FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE m.Genre='Comedy' AND m.Rating<7 AND CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(a.NetWorth,',',''),'$','') AS REAL)>375000000

SELECT c."Character Name" FROM movie m JOIN characters c ON c.MovieID=m.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID=c.ActorID WHERE m.Title='Bruce Almighty' AND a.Gender='Female' AND a."Birth City"='Sherman Oaks' AND a."Height (Inches)" > (SELECT AVG("Height (Inches)")*0.5 FROM actor)
